reasoningChain.evidence: The boss remains the only uncleared objective after the first full-party wipe.
The first boss attempt left three enemies alive, while the mage contributed only 8.36% damage and ranked fourth despite its new charm.
The learned boss rule rewards a frontline that can hold the flag long enough to create a counterattack window.
The rescued knight is available as a defensive frontline replacement.
Replacing the lowest-damage mage preserves the ranger and berserker who supplied 80.29% of prior boss damage, while adding the sustain the wipe showed was missing.
If frontline durability is the missing factor, the knight version should leave more player survivors or fewer enemy survivors on the next boss attempt.

hypothesis.problem: The direct-damage lineup was eliminated with three boss enemies still alive.
hypothesis.cause: The lineup lacked enough frontline durability to exploit the king-flag counterattack window.
